title: promote-release.mjs refuses to move latest without opum-cli-e2e's registry-install PASS for the exact lore/quest pair
description: opum-agent ruling A on OPAG-465 (2026-09-27, orchestrator bf4fd4b4), from a gap opum-cli-e2e raised: the QCLI-366 receipt gate covers publication under any tag, including release-candidate, but nothing mechanically gates the later latest move on the pass-2 qualification of the STAGED pair from clean registry installs (Article 3.5). A relayed PASS is the thing this removes (Article 3.6, enforced not remembered). opum-cli-e2e owns the receipt schema and location; promote-release.mjs (QCLI-385) reads it directly, the same way e2e-receipt.mjs reads the pass-1 receipt. The same verdict must gate lore's latest move, so the read is agreed with lore-cli. Fallback B, allowed for 0.11.0 only if this is not landed when e2e reports PASS: the orchestrator's go plus the owner's direct tier-3 authorization.

acceptanceCriteria.text: promote-release.mjs --promote refuses, before any tag moves, unless opum-cli-e2e's pass-2 receipt records PASS for this quest version paired with lore at the same version
An unreadable, malformed or non-PASS receipt refuses, and tests cover PASS, FAIL, wrong pair and read failure
--rollback is NOT gated on the receipt: restoring prior tags must always be possible
The schema read matches what opum-cli-e2e writes, confirmed with opum-cli-e2e, and lore-cli reads the same verdict

implementationNotes: Schema agreed with opum-cli-e2e 2026-09-27: their PR opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e#298 at head 36a6862, receipts/README.md "Pair receipts" and "What a reader must do" 1-4. Location receipts/pair/<v>.json on their main. kind opum.pair-qualification-receipt.v1. verdict QUALIFIED or a four-field override, printed verbatim. pair.quest.version and pair.lore.version both equal the version. pair.quest.commit equals npm gitHead. installedFrom.quest.source is "registry". pair.quest.tarballs keys are exactly the seven npm-pack names, and each distIntegrity equals npm dist.integrity at promotion time. e2e confirmed the seven key names. Lore digests are not checked, and the contract allows that.

Built, in PR (feat/QCLI-388-pair-receipt-gate). scripts/qualification/pair-receipt.mjs reads receipts/pair/<v>.json from opum-cli-e2e main through the shared fetchReceipt, and evaluates conditions 1-4 plus installedFrom.quest.source == "registry". The verdict and override logic is shared with pass 1 as evaluateVerdict. promote-release.mjs calls it once, on the promote path, before the dry-run exit; the rollback branch never reaches it. Evidence: test/qcli388-pair-receipt-gate.test.ts, 14 tests. Mutation control: disabling the lore-version and gitHead checks turned exactly the 2 predicted tests red, and restored gives 14/14. A live probe against 0.10.0 read npm 12 view output, which is a ONE-element array and not an object; the first draft would have read nothing, and the fix is under test. It refused on the real 404 for receipts/pair/0.10.0.json. bun run check exit 0, 759 tests. AC4 is left OPEN: opum-cli-e2e confirmed the reader against #298 head 36a6862, but #298 is not merged yet (their billing block), and lore-cli has not yet confirmed reading the same verdict. This task stays In Progress until both are true.

Update 2026-09-27: opum-cli-e2e#298 MERGED into THEIR dev as 9c1c612, from head cfe8e53 (one tracker-only commit after 86b23a8). 36a6862 to 86b23a8 changed receipts/README.md by 3 lines: override now carries the print-verbatim obligation. Our promote already prints it (describeOverride), so no code change. Their main b73e9c2 does not yet carry the Pair receipts section, and this reader reads receipts/pair/<v>.json from their main; I told opum-cli-e2e. AC4 is still open pending lore-cli.

HANDOFF at the session recycle, 2026-09-27. Left In Progress on purpose. ACs 1-3 are checked. The reader gated the real 0.11.0 latest move. Its first live dry run exposed a tarball-published defect, fixed as QCLI-393 (#322), which ported lore-cli's reader shape. opum-cli-e2e#298 merged and now carries the schema on their main. AC4 still needs lore-cli's confirmation that it reads the same verdict. lore's scripts/pair-receipt.mjs at lore main bb225f1c mirrors ours (whole-version view, tag-peel commit, gitHead agreement), which I read by API. What is missing is only their explicit confirmation, or their LCLI-613 landing SHA to cite. NEXT: cite lore's SHA, then check AC4 and complete.

Paused 2026-09-27 on the orchestrator's ruling: ACs 1-3 done; AC4 waits only on lore-cli's explicit confirmation that it reads the same pair-receipt verdict (opum-agent asked lore-cli to send it here).
